description: Hovering a launcher with a long application name changes the tooltip from absent to visible and shows the full name on one line.

assertions.comment: Before I hover the launcher, no text tooltip is requested.
After I rest the pointer on a launcher with no window, its text tooltip appears; the timer is outside the virtual clock, so I check the settled state.
The tooltip I opened shows the application name from the launcher file.
Before I hover the long-name launcher, its tooltip is absent from view.
After I hover the long-name launcher, the tooltip is visible so its layout is actually exercised.
The visible tooltip shows the full long application name rather than shortened text.
The full application name I see is not clipped or elided.
The long application name I see remains readable on one line.
